correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructs exact conserved K, canonical Hamiltonian, positive-definite Hessian and properness. Coarea gives period=area derivative; Brunn–Minkowski yields concavity of sqrt(area); dominated-convergence scaled triangle area gives slope, with a justified derivative limit. A controlled interior slow leg of duration (1-2δ)E/(ad)+o(E) yields the stated uniform time law as δ decreases. Symbolic checker verifies field identities; quadrature only corroborates finite energies.

value.rationale: Exact original-time high-energy period coefficient and joint log-abundance law solve a motivated quantitative question for an explicitly integrable but nonseparable three-population flow. The result reveals that one long slow leg dominates orbital statistics and is independent of fixed positive Casimir, distinguishing integrability and orbit existence from physical-time behavior.
